exercise.name: Weighted Back Extension
steps: Set up on the back extension bench and hug a plate to your chest.
Lower your upper body toward the floor with your back flat.
Rise until your body is in a straight line, then repeat.
exercise.one_line_summary: On a 45 deg back-extension bench, hips on the pad, ankles under the roller, a plate hugged to the chest with crossed arms. Start trunk lowered with a flat back (hip flexion ~75 deg); end body in one straight line along the 45 deg slope. Lower back is the target; glutes and hamstrings help.

setup.target: 45 deg back-extension bench: hip pad on the front of the thighs below the hip joints, ankles under the roller.
setup.tolerance: hip joints free above the pad
setup.why: S1 used a 45 deg Roman chair; library step 1.

setup.target: A plate held flat on the chest, forearms crossed over it.
setup.why: S1 loaded with plates held at the chest; library step 1.

movement.path: Hinges at the hips, back flat (library step 2).

muscles.emg: Erector spinae as high as the RDL (S1); unchanged by hip position (S2).
muscles.role: Holds the back flat and helps lift.
muscles.surface: The two ropes either side of the spine in the low back.
Back of the thigh, buttock to knee.

mistakes.mistake: Rounding the back at the bottom
mistakes.why_it_matters: Library step 2 says back flat; S1 kept it straight.

sources.citation: Andersen V, Pedersen H, Fimland MS, et al. 2021. Comparison of muscle activity in three single-joint, hip extension exercises in resistance-trained women. J Sports Sci Med 20:181-187. doi:10.52082/jssm.2021.181
sources.what_it_gave: 45 deg Roman chair with plates held at the chest, back straight, from upright down to ~90 deg hip flexion: biceps femoris 71-174% higher than RDL / machine, gluteus maximus 140% above the machine, erector spinae no different.

sources.citation: da Silva RA, Lariviere C, Arsenault AB, Nadeau S, Plamondon A. 2009. Effect of pelvic stabilization and hip position on trunk extensor activity during back extension exercises on a Roman chair. J Rehabil Med 41(3):136-142. doi:10.2340/16501977-0305
sources.what_it_gave: Roman chair: back and gluteus activity unchanged by pelvic strap or hip angle; biceps femoris works throughout.

sources.citation: Yoo WG. 2015. Comparison of the isolated contraction ratios of the hip extensors and erector spinae muscles of the lumbar region and thoracic muscles during different back extension exercises. J Phys Ther Sci 27(2):315-316. doi:10.1589/jpts.27.315
sources.what_it_gave: Back extension variants share the work between the lumbar and thoracic erector spinae and the gluteus maximus; the variant decides which leads.
The steps the app shows; the pictures must match them.

clip_check.check: Thighs on the hip pad, ankles under the roller
Plate on the chest, forearms over it
clip_check.target: plate does not cut into the chest or arms

clip_check.check: End: body straight on the 45 deg slope
Lower back strongest red; glutes, hamstrings lighter
